justification.text: Real division is total, but this divisor is never zero: n + 1 is a positive integer and sin k = 0 only when k is an integer multiple of π, which no non-zero integer is (π is irrational). So the junk value at 0 is never taken and the term is csc(n+1)^2 / (n+1)^3, as the informal series has it (0-indexed).
